text_blocks.snippet: Esophageal lichen planus (ELP) treatment often involves a combination of medical therapies and endoscopic procedures. Medical treatments may include systemic corticosteroids, topical steroids, immunosuppressants, and other medications. Endoscopic dilation is used for strictures and to relieve dysphagia.
